>> 00024: export function normalizeAnimal(value) {
   00025:   return String(value || "")
   00026:     .trim()
   00027:     .toUpperCase()
   00028:     .normalize("NFD")
   00029:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")

   00034: function onlyDigits(s) {
   00035:   return String(s || "").replace(/[^\d]/g, "");
   00036: }
   00037: 
   00038: function pad2(n) {
   00039:   return String(Number(n) || 0).padStart(2, "0");

   00042: function stripTrailingSlashes(s) {
   00043:   return String(s || "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
   00044: }
   00045: 
   00046: function ensureLeadingSlash(s) {
   00047:   const v = String(s || "").trim();
   00048:   if (!v) return "";
   00049:   return v.startsWith("/") ? v : `/${v}`;
   00050: }
   00051: 
   00052: /**
   00053:  * ✅ Base pública do app:
   00054:  * - Vite: import.meta.env.BASE_URL (normalmente "/")
   00055:  * - CRA: process.env.PUBLIC_URL
   00056:  * - fallback: ""
   00057:  *
   00058:  * Retorna "" (raiz) ou "/subpasta" (sem barra no final).
   00059:  */
   00060: function getPublicBase() {
   00061:   // Vite (preferência)
   00062:   try {
   00063:     const viteBase =
   00064:       typeof import.meta !== "undefined" &&
   00065:       import.meta.env &&
   00066:       typeof import.meta.env.BASE_URL === "string"
   00067:         ? String(import.meta.env.BASE_URL).trim()
   00068:         : "";
   00069: 
   00070:     // BASE_URL do Vite normalmente vem como "/" ou "/sub/"
   00071:     if (viteBase && viteBase !== "/") {
   00072:       return stripTrailingSlashes(ensureLeadingSlash(viteBase));
   00073:     }
   00074:   } catch {
   00075:     // noop
   00076:   }
   00077: 
   00078:   // CRA
   00079:   const craBase =
   00080:     typeof process !== "undefined" &&
   00081:     process.env &&
   00082:     typeof process.env.PUBLIC_URL === "string"
   00083:       ? String(process.env.PUBLIC_URL).trim()
   00084:       : "";
   00085: 
   00086:   if (craBase && craBase !== "/") {
   00087:     return stripTrailingSlashes(ensureLeadingSlash(craBase));
   00088:   }
   00089: 
   00090:   return "";
   00091: }
   00092: 
   00093: /**
   00094:  * ✅ Converte "qualquer coisa que represente grupo" em número 1..25
   00095:  * Aceita:
   00096:  * - 18
   00097:  * - "18"
   00098:  * - "018"
   00099:  * - "GRUPO 18"
   00100:  * - "Grupo 04"
   00101:  * - "G18"
   00102:  *
   00103:  * Proteção extra:
   00104:  * - evita "GRUPO 1 E 2" virar 12
   00105:  */
   00106: function coerceGrupoNumber(input) {
   00107:   if (input == null) return null;
   00108: 
   00109:   if (typeof input === "number") {
   00110:     const g = Math.trunc(input);
   00111:     if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
   00112:     if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
   00113:     return g;
   00114:   }
   00115: 
   00116:   const str = String(input || "").trim();
   00117:   if (!str) return null;
   00118: 
   00119:   // pega o PRIMEIRO match de 1 ou 2 dígitos
   00120:   const m = str.match(/\d{1,2}/);
   00121:   if (!m) return null;
   00122: 
   00123:   const g = Number(m[0]);
   00124:   if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
   00125:   if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
   00126:   return g;
   00127: }

   00229: export function guessPalpiteFromGrupo(grupo, ctx = null) {

   00231:     const digits = onlyDigits(ctx.palpite4).slice(-4);
   00232:     return digits ? digits.padStart(4, "0") : "----";
   00233:   }
   00234: 
   00235:   const b = getBichoByGrupo(grupo);
   00236:   if (!b) return "----";

   00240:     const uC = onlyDigits(ctx.unidadeCentena).slice(-1);
   00241:     const uM = onlyDigits(ctx.unidadeMilhar).slice(-1);
   00242: 
   00243:     if (dez) {
   00244:       const milhar = (uM || "0").slice(-1);
   00245:       const centena = (uC || "0").slice(-1);
   00246:       return `${milhar}${centena}${dez}`.padStart(4, "0");
   00247:     }
   00248:   }
   00249: 
   00250:   const dezFallback =
   00251:     Array.isArray(b.dezenas) && b.dezenas.length
   00252:       ? String(b.dezenas[b.dezenas.length - 1])
   00253:       : "00";
   00254: 
   00255:   const dez = onlyDigits(dezFallback).slice(-2) || "00";
   00256:   return `00${dez}`.padStart(4, "0");

   00266: function normalizeAllowedSize(size) {
   00267:   const allowed = [16, 24, 32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256];
   00268: 
   00269:   let s = Number(size);
   00270:   if (!Number.isFinite(s) || s <= 0) s = 96;

   00274:     if (s <= a) return a;
   00275:   }
   00276:   return 256;

   00033: function sortHoursAsc(arr) {
   00034:   return [...arr].sort((a, b) => {
   00035:     const [ha, ma] = a.split(":").map(Number);
   00036:     const [hb, mb] = b.split(":").map(Number);
   00037:     return ha * 60 + ma - (hb * 60 + mb);
   00038:   });

   00257: async function mapWithConcurrency(
   00258:   items,
   00259:   concurrency,
   00260:   worker
   00261: ) {
   00262:   const output = new Array(items.length);
   00263:   let cursor = 0;
   00264: 
   00265:   async function run() {
   00266:     while (true) {
   00267:       const index = cursor;
   00268:       cursor += 1;
   00269: 
   00270:       if (index >= items.length) {
   00271:         return;
   00272:       }
   00273: 
   00274:       output[index] = await worker(
   00275:         items[index],
   00276:         index
   00277:       );
   00278:     }
   00279:   }
   00280: 
   00281:   const runners = Array.from(
   00282:     {
   00283:       length: Math.max(
   00284:         1,
   00285:         Math.min(concurrency, items.length)
   00286:       ),
   00287:     },
   00288:     run
   00289:   );
   00290: 
   00291:   await Promise.all(runners);
   00292: 
   00293:   return output;
   00294: }

   00012: export function isYMD(s) {
   00013:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
   00014:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
   00015: 
   00016:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
   00017:   if (!Number.isFinite(y) || !Number.isFinite(m) || !Number.isFinite(d)) return false;
   00018:   if (m < 1 || m > 12) return false;
   00019:   if (d < 1 || d > 31) return false;
   00020: 
   00021:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
   00022:   return (
   00023:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
   00024:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
   00025:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
   00026:   );
   00027: }

   00320: export function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) {
   00321:   const out = [];
   00322:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
   00323:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
   00324: 
   00325:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
   00326:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
   00327:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, Number(chunkDays || DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) - 1);
   00328:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
   00329:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
   00330:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
   00331:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
   00332:     curFrom = next;
   00333:   }
   00334:   return out;
   00335: }

   00422: /* ========= utils: concorrência ========= */
   00423: 
   00424: export async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
   00425:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
   00426:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
   00427:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
   00428: 
   00429:   let idx = 0;
   00430: 
   00431:   async function worker() {
   00432:     // ✅ claim seguro do próximo índice
   00433:     // (evita disputa em cenários com yield/microtasks)
   00434:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
   00435:     while (true) {
   00436:       const current = idx;
   00437:       idx += 1;
   00438:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
   00439:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
   00440:     }
   00441:   }

   00328: function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = CHUNK_DAYS) {
   00329:   const out = [];
   00330:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
   00331:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
   00332: 
   00333:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
   00334:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
   00335:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, chunkDays - 1);
   00336:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
   00337:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
   00338:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
   00339:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
   00340:     curFrom = next;
   00341:   }
   00342:   return out;
   00343: }

   00419: function digitFromKey(key) {
   00420:   const s = String(key || "");
   00421:   let h = 0;

   00427: /* ========= utils: concorrência ========= */
   00428: 
   00429: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
   00430:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
   00431:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
   00432:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
   00433:   let idx = 0;
   00434: 
   00435:   async function worker() {
   00436:     while (idx < arr.length) {
   00437:       const current = idx++;
   00438:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
   00439:     }
   00440:   }
   00441: 
   00442:   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker));
   00443:   return results;
   00444: }

   00035:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");

   00038: /** ✅ Normaliza "qualquer data" para YYYY-MM-DD (ou null). */
   00039: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
   00040:   if (!input) return null;
   00041: 
   00042:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
   00043:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
   00044:     const d = input.toDate();
   00045:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00046:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00047:         d.getUTCDate()
   00048:       )}`;
   00049:     }
   00050:   }
   00051: 
   00052:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
   00053:   if (
   00054:     typeof input === "object" &&
   00055:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
   00056:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
   00057:   ) {
   00058:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
   00059:       ? Number(input.seconds)
   00060:       : Number(input._seconds);
   00061: 
   00062:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
   00063:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00064:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00065:         d.getUTCDate()
   00066:       )}`;
   00067:     }
   00068:   }
   00069: 
   00070:   // Date
   00071:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
   00072:     return `${input.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00073:       input.getUTCDate()
   00074:     )}`;
   00075:   }
   00076: 
   00077:   const s = String(input).trim();
   00078:   if (!s) return null;
   00079: 
   00080:   // YYYY-MM-DD...
   00081:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
   00082:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
   00083: 
   00084:   // DD/MM/YYYY
   00085:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
   00086:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
   00087: 
   00088:   return null;
   00089: }
   00090:

   00151: /** ✅ Normaliza close_hour para HH:MM */
   00152: function normHHMM(value) {
   00153:   const s0 = String(value || "").trim();
   00154:   if (!s0) return null;
   00155: 
   00156:   const s = s0.toLowerCase();
   00157: 
   00158:   // "09:00h" / "09:00"
   00159:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?\s*h?$/i);
   00160:   if (mISO) {
   00161:     const hh = String(mISO[1]).padStart(2, "0");
   00162:     const mm = String(mISO[2]).padStart(2, "0");
   00163:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
   00164:   }
   00165: 
   00166:   // "09h00" / "9h00" / "09h00m"
   00167:   const mhm = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*(\d{1,2})?\s*(m|min)?\s*s?$/i);
   00168:   if (mhm) {
   00169:     const hh = String(mhm[1]).padStart(2, "0");
   00170:     const mm = String(mhm[2] ?? "0").padStart(2, "0");
   00171:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
   00172:   }
   00173: 
   00174:   // "9h" / "09h" / "09hs"
   00175:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*s?$/i);
   00176:   if (mh) return `${String(mh[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
   00177: 
   00178:   // "9" / "09"
   00179:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
   00180:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
   00181: 
   00182:   return null;
   00183: }

   00185: /** ✅ Mapeia HH:MM -> BUCKET "09h" etc. */
   00186: function hhmmToBucket09h(value) {
   00187:   const hhmm = normHHMM(value);
   00188:   if (!hhmm) return null;
   00189:   const hh = hhmm.slice(0, 2);
   00190:   if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(hh)) return null;
   00191:   return `${hh}h`;
   00192: }

   00209: /** ✅ DEDUPE conservador (sem colapsar draws reais) */

   00212:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
   00213:

   00224:         const g = String(pz?.grupo ?? pz?.group ?? pz?.g ?? "").replace(
   00225:           /\D/g,

   01161: function computeStats({ drawsRawView, drawsRawGlobal, filters, selectedGrupo }) {
   01162:   const drawsView = dedupeDraws(drawsRawView);
   01163:   const drawsGlobal = dedupeDraws(drawsRawGlobal);
   01164: 
   01165:   const gSel = Number(selectedGrupo);
   01166:   const hasSelected = Number.isFinite(gSel) && gSel >= 1 && gSel <= 25;
   01167: 
   01168:   const expectedPositions = parseExpectedPositionsFromFilters(filters);
   01169:   const selectedPosOrNull = normalizePosFilter(filters);
   01170: 
   01171:   const draws = hasSelected
   01172:     ? drawsView.filter((d) => drawHasGrupo(d, gSel))
   01173:     : drawsView;
   01174: 
   01175:   const yearsSet = new Set();
   01176:   for (const d of draws) {
   01177:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
   01178:     if (!ymd) continue;
   01179:     const y = Number(ymd.slice(0, 4));
   01180:     if (Number.isFinite(y) && y > 1900) yearsSet.add(y);
   01181:   }
   01182:   const isMultiYear = yearsSet.size > 1;
   01183: 
   01184:   const monthOrder = [
   01185:     "Janeiro",
   01186:     "Fevereiro",
   01187:     "Março",
   01188:     "Abril",
   01189:     "Maio",
   01190:     "Junho",
   01191:     "Julho",
   01192:     "Agosto",
   01193:     "Setembro",
   01194:     "Outubro",
   01195:     "Novembro",
   01196:     "Dezembro",

   01198: 
   01199:   let totalAparicoesNoRecorte = 0;
   01200:   for (const d of draws) {
   01201:     totalAparicoesNoRecorte += countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
   01202:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
   01203:       selectedPosOrNull,
   01204:       expectedPositions,
   01205:     });
   01206:   }
   01207: 
   01208:   const monthMap = new Map();
   01209:   for (const d of draws) {
   01210:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
   01211:     const m = ymd ? getMonthPT(ymd) : null;
   01212:     if (!m) continue;
   01213: 
   01214:     const apar = countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
   01215:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
   01216:       selectedPosOrNull,
   01217:       expectedPositions,
   01218:     });
   01219: 
   01220:     monthMap.set(m, (monthMap.get(m) || 0) + apar);
   01221:   }
   01222: 
   01223:   const monthDataDisplay = monthOrder.map((m) => ({
   01224:     label: m,
   01225:     value: monthMap.get(m) || 0,
   01226:   }));
   01227: 
   01228:   const wdOrder = [
   01229:     { key: "Dom", label: "domingo" },
   01230:     { key: "Seg", label: "segunda-feira" },
   01231:     { key: "Ter", label: "terça-feira" },
   01232:     { key: "Qua", label: "quarta-feira" },
   01233:     { key: "Qui", label: "quinta-feira" },
   01234:     { key: "Sex", label: "sexta-feira" },
   01235:     { key: "Sáb", label: "sábado" },
   01236:   ];
   01237: 
   01238:   const wdMap = new Map(wdOrder.map((k) => [k.key, 0]));
   01239: 
   01240:   for (const d of draws) {
   01241:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
   01242:     if (!ymd) continue;
   01243: 
   01244:     const [y, m, dd] = ymd.split("-").map(Number);
   01245:     if (!y || !m || !dd) continue;
   01246: 
   01247:     const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, dd));
   01248:     const w = dt.getUTCDay();
   01249:     const map = ["Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb"];
   01250:     const wd = map[w] || null;
   01251:     if (!wd) continue;
   01252: 
   01253:     const apar = countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
   01254:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
   01255:       selectedPosOrNull,

   01257:     });
   01258: 
   01259:     wdMap.set(wd, (wdMap.get(wd) || 0) + apar);
   01260:   }
   01261: 
   01262:   const weekdayData = wdOrder.map((it) => ({
   01263:     label: it.label,
   01264:     value: wdMap.get(it.key) || 0,
   01265:   }));
   01266: 
   01267:   const ALLOWED_BUCKETS = ["09h", "11h", "14h", "16h", "18h", "21h"];
   01268:   const hourMap = new Map(ALLOWED_BUCKETS.map((b) => [b, 0]));
   01269:   let aparicoesComHoraTotal = 0;

   01273:     if (!bucket) continue;

   01296:   let posRankingModel = null;

   01306:     }

   01309: 
   01310:     const grpCount = countGrupoAparicoes(draws, gSel, expectedPositions);
   01311: 
   01312:     posRankingModel = {
   01313:       mode: "dist",
>> 01314:       header: "Aparições do animal por posição",
>> 01315:       animalLabel: String(selectedAnimalLabel || "").trim(),
   01316:       items: grpCount.byPos,
   01317:     };

   01326:   const aparicoesGlobal25 = buildGlobalAparicoes25(drawsGlobal);

   00030: 
   00031: function pad2(n) {
   00032:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
   00033: }
   00034: 
   00035: function isISODate(s) {
   00036:   return /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.test(String(s || ""));
   00037: }
   00038: 
   00039: function formatBR(iso) {
   00040:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return "";
   00041:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-");
   00042:   return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
   00043: }
   00044: 
   00045: function toUTCDate(iso) {
   00046:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return null;
   00047:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
   00048:   if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
   00049:   return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
   00050: }
   00051: 
   00052: function fromUTCDate(dt) {
   00053:   if (!(dt instanceof Date) || !Number.isFinite(dt.getTime())) return null;
   00054:   const y = dt.getUTCFullYear();
   00055:   const m = pad2(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   00056:   const d = pad2(dt.getUTCDate());
   00057:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
   00058: }
   00059: 
   00060: function clamp(n, a, b) {
   00061:   return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));
   00062: }
   00063: 
   00064: function clampDateISO(iso, minISO, maxISO) {
   00065:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
   00066:   const minDt = toUTCDate(minISO);
   00067:   const maxDt = toUTCDate(maxISO);
   00068: 
   00069:   if (!minDt || !maxDt) return isISODate(iso) ? iso : null;
   00070:   if (!dt) return maxISO;
   00071: 
   00072:   const clamped = new Date(clamp(dt.getTime(), minDt.getTime(), maxDt.getTime()));
   00073:   return fromUTCDate(clamped) || maxISO;
   00074: }
   00075: 
   00076: function daysBetweenUTC(aISO, bISO) {
   00077:   const a = toUTCDate(aISO);
   00078:   const b = toUTCDate(bISO);
   00079:   if (!a || !b) return 0;
   00080:   const ms = b.getTime() - a.getTime();
   00081:   if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return 0;
   00082:   return Math.floor(ms / 86400000);
   00083: }
   00084: 
   00085: function addDaysUTC(iso, days) {
   00086:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
   00087:   if (!dt) return iso;
   00088:   dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + Number(days || 0));
   00089:   return fromUTCDate(dt);
   00090: }

>> 00045: function normalizeLoteriaInput(v) {
   00046:   const raw = String(v ?? "").trim();
   00047:   if (!raw) return "PT_RIO";
   00048: 
   00049:   const key = raw
   00050:     .toLowerCase()
   00051:     .normalize("NFD")
   00052:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
   00053:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   00054:     .trim();
   00055: 
   00056:   if (key === "federal" || key === "fed" || key === "br" || key === "brasil")
   00057:     return "FEDERAL";
   00058:   if (key === "rj" || key === "rio" || key === "pt_rio" || key === "pt-rio")
   00059:     return "PT_RIO";
   00060: 
   00061:   const out = key
   00062:     .toUpperCase()
   00063:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_")
   00064:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
   00065: 
   00066:   return out || "PT_RIO";
   00067: }

   00079:   if (mOrd) return `${Number(mOrd[1])}º`;

   00081:   return s;
   00082: }

   00133: /** Garante que o value exista na lista */
   00134: function ensureValueInList({
   00135:   value,
   00136:   list,
   00137:   forceValue = null,
>> 00138:   fallback = "Todos",
   00139:   normalizeFn = null,
   00140: }) {
   00141:   const base = forceValue ?? value;
   00142:   const v0 = normalizeValue(base, fallback);
   00143:   const v = typeof normalizeFn === "function" ? normalizeFn(v0) : v0;
   00144: 
   00145:   const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
   00146:   if (!arr.length) return v;
   00147: 
   00148:   const isObjList = typeof arr[0] === "object" && arr[0] && "value" in arr[0];
   00149: 
   00150:   const norm = (x) => {
   00151:     const s = normalizeValue(x, "");
   00152:     return typeof normalizeFn === "function" ? normalizeFn(s) : s;
   00153:   };
   00154: 
   00155:   if (isObjList) {
   00156:     const values = new Set(arr.map((x) => norm(x?.value)));
   00157:     if (values.has(v)) return v;
>> 00158:     if (values.has("Todos")) return "Todos";
   00159:     const first = norm(arr[0]?.value);
   00160:     return first || fallback;
   00161:   }
   00162: 
   00163:   const values = new Set(arr.map((x) => norm(x)));
   00164:   if (values.has(v)) return v;
>> 00165:   if (values.has("Todos")) return "Todos";
   00166: 
   00167:   const first = norm(arr[0]);
   00168:   return first || fallback;
   00169: }

   00028: function digitsOnly(v) {
   00029:   const s = String(v ?? "").trim();
   00030:   if (!s) return "";
   00031:   return s.replace(/\D+/g, "");
   00032: }
   00033: 
   00034: function toMilhar4(v) {
   00035:   const d = digitsOnly(v);
   00036:   if (!d) return null;
   00037:   return d.length >= 4 ? d.slice(-4).padStart(4, "0") : d.padStart(4, "0");
   00038: }
   00039: 
   00040: function safeNumber(n) {
   00041:   const x = Number(n);
   00042:   return Number.isFinite(x) ? x : 0;
   00043: }
   00044: 
   00045: function pickAparCount(r) {
   00046:   return safeNumber(
   00047:     r?.total ??
   00048:       r?.apar ??
   00049:       r?.aparicoes ??
   00050:       r?.aparições ??
   00051:       r?.count ??
   00052:       r?.value ??
   00053:       0
   00054:   );
   00055: }
   00056: 
   00057: function fmtIntPT(n) {
   00058:   const x = safeNumber(n);
   00059:   try {
   00060:     return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(x);
   00061:   } catch {
   00062:     return String(x);
   00063:   }
   00064: }
   00065: 
   00066: function normalizeGrupoNumber(v) {
   00067:   const s = String(v ?? "").trim();
   00068:   if (!s) return 0;
   00069:   const n = Number(s);
   00070:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
   00071: }
   00072: 
   00073: function grupoTo2(g) {
   00074:   const n = normalizeGrupoNumber(g);
   00075:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
   00076: }
   00077: 
   00078: function uniq(arr) {
   00079:   return Array.from(new Set(arr.filter(Boolean)));
   00080: }
   00081: 
   00082: function safeStr(v) {
   00083:   return String(v ?? "").trim();
   00084: }

   00086: /** ✅ Gera candidatos de imagem (robusto) */
   00087: function buildImgCandidates(getImgFromGrupo, grupo) {
   00088:   const base96 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 96));
   00089:   const base128 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 128));
   00090:   const base64 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 64));
   00091: 
   00092:   const bases = [base128, base96, base64].filter(Boolean);
   00093: 
   00094:   const out = [];
   00095:   for (const src of bases) {
   00096:     out.push(src);
   00097: 
   00098:     if (/\.png(\?|#|$)/i.test(src)) {
   00099:       out.push(src.replace(/\.png(\?|#|$)/i, ".jpg$1"));
   00100:       out.push(src.replace(/\.png(\?|#|$)/i, ".jpeg$1"));
   00101:     }
   00102: 
   00103:     if (/\.jpe?g(\?|#|$)/i.test(src)) {
   00104:       out.push(src.replace(/\.jpe?g(\?|#|$)/i, ".png$1"));
   00105:     }
   00106:   }
   00107: 
   00108:   return uniq(out);
   00109: }

   00031: function hourBucketFromAny(value) {
   00032:   const s0 = safeStr(value);
   00033:   if (!s0) return "";
   00034: 
   00035:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   00036: 
   00037:   // "11h", "11hs", "11hr"...
   00038:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
   00039:   if (mh) return `${pad2(mh[1])}h`;
   00040: 
   00041:   // "11:10" ou "11:00" ou "11:10:00"
   00042:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?$/);
   00043:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}h`;
   00044: 
   00045:   // "11"
   00046:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
   00047:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}h`;
   00048: 
   00049:   return s0; // fallback (não deveria)
   00050: }

   00221: function normalizeRangeWithBounds(fromIn, toIn, minDate, maxDate) {
   00222:   let from = clampYmd(fromIn, minDate, maxDate);
   00223:   let to = clampYmd(toIn, minDate, maxDate);
   00224: 
   00225:   const fallback = clampYmd(todayYMDLocal(), minDate, maxDate) || maxDate || minDate || todayYMDLocal();
   00226: 
   00227:   if (!from) from = fallback;
   00228:   if (!to) to = from;
   00229: 
   00230:   if (from > to) [from, to] = [to, from];
   00231: 
   00232:   return { from, to };
   00233: }

   00241:   const a = document.createElement("a");

   00243:   a.download = filename;
   00244:   document.body.appendChild(a);
   00245:   a.click();
   00246:   a.remove();
   00247:   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   00248: }

   00047:   const m = String(ymd || "")
   00048:     .trim()
   00049:     .match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);

   00054: function ymdToUTCDate(ymd) {
   00055:   const m = String(ymd || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   00056:   if (!m) return null;

   00060: function diffDaysUTC(aYmd, bYmd) {
   00061:   const a = ymdToUTCDate(aYmd);
   00062:   const b = ymdToUTCDate(bYmd);

   00082: /**

   00086: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
   00087:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
   00088:   if (!s0) return "";
   00089: 
   00090:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   00091:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
   00092:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
   00093: 
   00094:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
   00095:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
   00096: 
   00097:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
   00098:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
   00099: 
   00100:   return s0.trim();
   00101: }

   00103: /**

   00106: function hourToMinutes(hhmm) {
   00107:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
   00108:   const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
   00109:   if (!m) return null;
   00110:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
   00111:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
   00112:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;
   00113:   return hh * 60 + mm;
   00114: }

   00120: function toHourBucket(value) {

   00127: /**

   00130: function unwrapDraws(maybe) {
   00131:   if (Array.isArray(maybe)) return maybe;
   00132:   if (maybe && typeof maybe === "object") {
   00133:     if (Array.isArray(maybe.drawsRaw)) return maybe.drawsRaw;
   00134:     if (Array.isArray(maybe.draws)) return maybe.draws;
   00135:     if (Array.isArray(maybe.rows)) return maybe.rows;
   00136:     if (Array.isArray(maybe.data)) return maybe.data;
   00137:   }
   00138:   return [];
   00139: }
   00140: 
   00141: /**
   00142:  * ✅ Pega a maior close_hour existente em um conjunto de draws
   00143:  * Retorna { ymd, closeHour }.
   00144:  */
   00145: function pickLatestCloseHour(drawsLike) {
   00146:   const arr = unwrapDraws(drawsLike);
   00147:   let best = null;
   00148:   let bestMin = -1;
   00149: 
   00150:   for (const d of arr) {
   00151:     const ch = normalizeHourLike(d?.close_hour || d?.closeHour || d?.hour || d?.hora || "");
   00152:     const min = hourToMinutes(ch);
   00153:     if (min == null) continue;
   00154:     if (min > bestMin) {
   00155:       bestMin = min;
   00156:       best = { ymd: d?.ymd || d?.date || "", closeHour: ch || "" };
   00157:     }
   00158:   }
   00159: 
   00160:   return best;
   00161: }
   00162: 
   00163: // escolhe "mais recente" entre (ymd + closeHour)
   00164: function isMoreRecent(a, b) {
   00165:   const ay = String(a?.lastYmd || "");
   00166:   const by = String(b?.lastYmd || "");
   00167:   if (ay && by && ay !== by) return ay > by;
   00168: 
   00169:   const am = hourToMinutes(a?.lastCloseHour || "");
   00170:   const bm = hourToMinutes(b?.lastCloseHour || "");
   00171:   if (am != null && bm != null && am !== bm) return am > bm;
   00172: 
   00173:   if (ay && !by) return true;
   00174:   if (!ay && by) return false;
   00175: 
   00176:   return false;
   00177: }

   00179: // merge de múltiplas consultas (ex: 1º ao 5º) => pega a última aparição mais recente por grupo
   00180: function mergeLateLists(lists, baseYmd) {
   00181:   const byGrupo = new Map();
   00182: 
   00183:   for (const list of lists) {
   00184:     const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
   00185:     for (const r of arr) {
   00186:       const g = Number(r?.grupo);
   00187:       if (!isValidGrupo(g)) continue;
   00188: 
   00189:       const candidate = {
   00190:         grupo: g,
   00191:         lastYmd: r?.lastYmd || null,
   00192:         // ✅ normaliza aqui (evita “09h/09HS/9”)
   00193:         lastCloseHour: r?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(r.lastCloseHour) : "",
   00194:       };
   00195: 
   00196:       if (!byGrupo.has(g)) {
   00197:         byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
   00198:         continue;
   00199:       }
   00200: 
   00201:       const prev = byGrupo.get(g);
   00202:       if (isMoreRecent(candidate, prev)) byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
   00203:     }
   00204:   }
   00205: 
   00206:   const out = [];
   00207:   for (let g = 1; g <= 25; g += 1) {
   00208:     const rec = byGrupo.get(g) || { grupo: g, lastYmd: null, lastCloseHour: "" };
   00209:     const lastYmd = rec?.lastYmd || null;
   00210:     const lastCloseHour = rec?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(rec.lastCloseHour) : "";
   00211:     const daysLate = lastYmd ? diffDaysUTC(lastYmd, baseYmd) : null;
   00212: 
   00213:     out.push({
   00214:       grupo: g,
   00215:       grupo2: toGrupo2(g),
   00216:       lastYmd,
   00217:       lastCloseHour,
   00218:       daysLate,
   00219:     });
   00220:   }

   00505: function pickBetterDraw(a, b) {
   00506:   const pa = countPrizes(a);
   00507:   const pb = countPrizes(b);
   00508:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
   00509: 
   00510:   const ha = safeStr(a?.close_hour || a?.closeHour || a?.hour || a?.hora);
   00511:   const hb = safeStr(b?.close_hour || b?.closeHour || b?.hour || b?.hora);
   00512:   if (!!hb !== !!ha) return hb ? b : a;
   00513: 
   00514:   return a;
   00515: }

   00517: function dedupeDraws(list, scopeKey, ymd) {
   00518:   const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
   00519:   const map = new Map();
   00520: 
   00521:   for (const d of arr) {
   00522:     const k = drawKeyForDedup(d, scopeKey, ymd);
   00523:     const prev = map.get(k);
   00524:     if (!prev) map.set(k, d);
   00525:     else map.set(k, pickBetterDraw(prev, d));
   00526:   }
   00527: 
   00528:   return Array.from(map.values());
   00529: }

   00013:  * - 3 dígitos => centena (últimos 3) ✅ preserva zero à esquerda

   00164: function ymdToUtcDate(ymd) {
   00165:   if (!isYMD(ymd)) return null;
   00166:   const [y, m, d] = ymd.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
   00167:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
   00168:   return Number.isNaN(dt.getTime()) ? null : dt;
   00169: }

   00171: function utcDateToYmd(dt) {
   00172:   const y = dt.getUTCFullYear();
   00173:   const m = pad2(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   00174:   const d = pad2(dt.getUTCDate());
   00175:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
   00176: }
   00177: 
   00178: function addDaysUtc(ymd, days) {
   00179:   const dt = ymdToUtcDate(ymd);
   00180:   if (!dt) return null;
   00181:   dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + Number(days || 0));
   00182:   return utcDateToYmd(dt);
   00183: }

   00185: function splitRangeYmd(from, to, chunkDays = 60) {
   00186:   if (!isYMD(from) || !isYMD(to)) return [];
   00187:   if (from > to) return [];
   00188: 
   00189:   const out = [];
   00190:   let cur = from;
   00191: 
   00192:   while (cur <= to) {
   00193:     const endCandidate = addDaysUtc(cur, chunkDays - 1);
   00194:     const end = endCandidate && endCandidate < to ? endCandidate : to;
   00195:     out.push({ from: cur, to: end });
   00196:     const next = addDaysUtc(end, 1);
   00197:     if (!next) break;
   00198:     cur = next;
   00199:   }
   00200:   return out;
   00201: }

   00494: async function runPool(items, worker, concurrency = 3) {
   00495:   const queue = [...items];
   00496:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, concurrency) }, async () => {
   00497:     while (queue.length) {
   00498:       const it = queue.shift();
   00499:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
   00500:       await worker(it);
   00501:     }
   00502:   });
   00503:   await Promise.all(runners);
   00504: }

   00001: import {

   00005: } from "./top3.engine";

   00007: import { isYMD, toHourBucket, hourToInt } from "./top3.formatters";
   00008: 
   00009: /*
   00010: TOP3+ — Cadeia de Bichos
   00011: Modelo de transição de grupos
   00012: 
   00013: - Entende targetYmd / targetHourBucket
   00014: - Encontra o draw imediatamente anterior ao alvo
>> 00015: - Separa transições por faixa de horário
   00016: - Evita ordenar sorteio sem hora como 00h
   00017: - Evita vazamento usando apenas histórico anterior ao alvo no modo target_aware
   00018: */
   00019: 
   00020: function safeInt(v, fallback = 0) {
   00021:   const n = Number(v);
   00022:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
   00023: }
   00024: 
   00025: function drawSortTs(draw) {
   00026:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
   00027:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
   00028: 
   00029:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00030: 
   00031:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
   00032:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00033: 
   00034:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
   00035:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
   00036: 
   00037:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
   00038: }
   00039: 
   00040: function slotTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
   00041:   const safeYmd = String(ymd || "").trim();
   00042:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
   00043: 
   00044:   if (!isYMD(safeYmd) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00045: 
   00046:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
   00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00048: 
   00049:   const [Y, M, D] = safeYmd.split("-").map(Number);
   00050:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
   00051: 
   00052:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
   00053: }
   00054: 
   00055: function dedupeAndSortDraws(draws) {
   00056:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
   00057:   const map = new Map();
   00058: 
   00059:   for (const d of list) {
   00060:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
   00061:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
   00062:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
   00063: 
   00064:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
   00065: 
   00066:     const key =
   00067:       String(d?.id || d?.drawId || "").trim() ||
   00068:       (isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "");
   00069: 
   00070:     if (!key) continue;
   00071: 
   00072:     const prev = map.get(key);
   00073: 
   00074:     if (!prev || ts < drawSortTs(prev)) {
   00075:       map.set(key, d);
   00076:     }
   00077:   }
   00078: 
   00079:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawSortTs(a) - drawSortTs(b));
   00080: }
   00081: 
   00082: function makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour) {
   00083:   const from = toHourBucket(fromHour);
   00084:   const to = toHourBucket(toHour);
   00085: 
   00086:   if (!from || !to) return "";
   00087: 
   00088:   return `${from}->${to}`;
   00089: }
   00090: 
   00091: function getNestedMap(map, key) {
   00092:   if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, new Map());
   00093:   return map.get(key);
   00094: }
   00095: 
   00096: function getHistoryBeforeTarget(draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket) {
   00097:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
   00098:   const target = slotTs(targetYmd, targetHourBucket);
   00099: 
   00100:   if (!list.length || !Number.isFinite(target)) return [];
   00101: 
   00102:   return list.filter((d) => {
   00103:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
   00104:     return Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < target;
   00105:   });
   00106: }
   00107: 
   00108: export function computeChainTransitions(draws) {
   00109:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
   00110:   const transitionsAny = new Map();
   00111:   const transitionsByEdge = new Map();
   00112: 
   00113:   for (let i = 0; i < list.length - 1; i += 1) {
   00114:     const fromDraw = list[i];
   00115:     const toDraw = list[i + 1];
   00116: 
   00117:     const fromGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(fromDraw));
   00118:     const toGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(toDraw));
   00119:     const fromHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(fromDraw));
   00120:     const toHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(toDraw));
   00121: 
   00122:     if (!Number.isFinite(fromGrupo) || !Number.isFinite(toGrupo)) continue;
   00123:     if (fromGrupo < 1 || fromGrupo > 25) continue;
   00124:     if (toGrupo < 1 || toGrupo > 25) continue;
   00125:     if (!fromHour || !toHour) continue;
   00126: 
   00127:     const anyRow = getNestedMap(transitionsAny, fromGrupo);
   00128:     anyRow.set(toGrupo, safeInt(anyRow.get(toGrupo), 0) + 1);
   00129: 
   00130:     const edgeKey = makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour);
   00131:     if (!edgeKey) continue;
   00132: 
   00133:     const edgeMap = getNestedMap(transitionsByEdge, edgeKey);
   00134:     const edgeRow = getNestedMap(edgeMap, fromGrupo);

   00195: function ymdHourToTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
   00196:   const y = safeStr(ymd);
   00197:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
   00198: 
   00199:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00200: 
   00201:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
   00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
   00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   00204:   }
   00205: 
   00206:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
   00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
   00208: 
   00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
   00210: }

   00195: function ymdHourToTs(ymd, hourBucket) {

   00198:

   00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
   00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

   00205:

   00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
   00208: 
   00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
   00210: }

   00060: export function normalizeToYMD(input) {
   00061:   if (input == null) return null;
   00062: 
   00063:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
   00064:     return dateToLocalYMD(input.toDate());
   00065:   }
   00066: 
   00067:   if (
   00068:     typeof input === "object" &&
   00069:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
   00070:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
   00071:   ) {
   00072:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
   00073:       ? Number(input.seconds)
   00074:       : Number(input._seconds);
   00075: 
   00076:     return dateToLocalYMD(new Date(sec * 1000));
   00077:   }
   00078: 
   00079:   if (input instanceof Date) {
   00080:     return dateToLocalYMD(input);
   00081:   }
   00082: 
   00083:   if (typeof input === "number" && Number.isFinite(input)) {
   00084:     const ms = input > 1e12 ? input : input * 1000;
   00085:     return dateToLocalYMD(new Date(ms));
   00086:   }
   00087: 
   00088:   const s = safeStr(input);
   00089:   if (!s) return null;
   00090: 
   00091:   if (/^\d{10,13}$/.test(s)) {
   00092:     const n = Number(s);
   00093:     const ms = s.length >= 13 ? n : n * 1000;
   00094:     return dateToLocalYMD(new Date(ms));
   00095:   }
   00096: 
   00097:   const isoFull = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   00098:   if (isoFull) {
   00099:     const ymd = `${isoFull[1]}-${isoFull[2]}-${isoFull[3]}`;
   00100:     return isYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
   00101:   }
   00102: 
   00103:   const isoPrefix = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})[T\s]/);
   00104:   if (isoPrefix) {
   00105:     const ymd = `${isoPrefix[1]}-${isoPrefix[2]}-${isoPrefix[3]}`;
   00106:     return isYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
   00107:   }
   00108: 
   00109:   const isoSlash = s.match(/^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})(?:\D.*)?$/);
   00110:   if (isoSlash) {
   00111:     const ymd = `${isoSlash[1]}-${isoSlash[2]}-${isoSlash[3]}`;
   00112:     return isYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
   00113:   }

   00115:   const compact = s.match(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/);

   00117:     const ymd = `${compact[1]}-${compact[2]}-${compact[3]}`;
   00118:     return isYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
   00119:   }
   00120:

   00125: }

   00117: function mergeBaseIntoRange(rangeDraws, baseDraw) {
   00118:   const list = Array.isArray(rangeDraws) ? rangeDraws : [];
   00119:   const key = drawKey(baseDraw);
   00120: 
   00121:   if (!key) return list;
   00122: 
   00123:   const map = new Map();
   00124: 
   00125:   for (const d of list) {
   00126:     const k = drawKey(d);
   00127:     if (k) map.set(k, d);
   00128:   }
   00129: 
   00130:   if (!map.has(key)) {
   00131:     map.set(key, baseDraw);
   00132:   }
   00133: 
   00134:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawTs(a) - drawTs(b));
   00135: }

   00260: function hasOfficialResult(slot) {

   00268: function analyzeTop3Hit(top3, resultGrupo, resultMilhar) {
   00269:   if (!Array.isArray(top3) || !top3.length) {
   00270:     return { type: "none", score: 0, position: -1, matchedValue: "" };
   00271:   }
   00272: 
   00273:   const grupoNum = Number(resultGrupo);
   00274:   const milhar = normalizeMilharStr(resultMilhar);
   00275:   const centena = milhar ? milhar.slice(-3) : "";
   00276: 
   00277:   const hasGrupo = Number.isFinite(grupoNum) && grupoNum >= 1 && grupoNum <= 25;
   00278:   const hasMilhar = /^\d{4}$/.test(milhar);
   00279: 
   00280:   if (!hasGrupo && !hasMilhar) {
   00281:     return { type: "none", score: 0, position: -1, matchedValue: "" };
   00282:   }
   00283: 
   00284:   let best = { type: "miss", score: 0, position: -1, matchedValue: "" };
   00285: 
   00286:   top3.forEach((item, idx) => {
   00287:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
   00288: 
   00289:     const milharesRaw = Array.isArray(item?.milhares20)
   00290:       ? item.milhares20
   00291:       : Array.isArray(item?.milhares)
   00292:         ? item.milhares
   00293:         : [];
   00294: 
   00295:     const milhares = milharesRaw
   00296:       .map((m) => normalizeMilharStr(m))
   00297:       .filter((m) => /^\d{4}$/.test(m));
   00298: 
   00299:     const centenas = milhares
   00300:       .map((m) => centenaFromMilhar(m))
   00301:       .filter((c) => /^\d{3}$/.test(c));
   00302: 
   00303:     let score = 0;
   00304:     let type = "miss";
   00305:     let matchedValue = "";
   00306: 
   00307:     if (hasMilhar && milhares.includes(milhar)) {
   00308:       score = 100;
   00309:       type = "hit_exact";
   00310:       matchedValue = milhar;
   00311:     } else if (centena && centenas.includes(centena)) {
   00312:       score = 66.67;
   00313:       type = "hit_centena";
   00314:       matchedValue = centena;
   00315:     } else if (hasGrupo && g === grupoNum) {
   00316:       score = 33.33;
   00317:       type = "hit_grupo";
   00318:       matchedValue = hasMilhar ? milhar.slice(-2) : formatGrupo(grupoNum);
   00319:     }
   00320: 
   00321:     if (score > best.score) {
   00322:       best = {
   00323:         type,
   00324:         score,
   00325:         position: idx + 1,
   00326:         matchedValue,
   00327:       };
   00328:     }
   00329:   });
   00330: 
   00331:   return best;
   00332: }

   00334: function ImgWithFallback({ srcs, alt, size = 84, style }) {
   00335:   const list = useMemo(
   00336:     () => (Array.isArray(srcs) ? srcs.filter(Boolean) : []),
   00337:     [srcs]
   00338:   );
   00339: 
   00340:   const [i, setI] = useState(0);
   00341:   const listKey = useMemo(() => list.join("|"), [list]);
   00342: 
   00343:   useEffect(() => {
   00344:     setI(0);
   00345:   }, [listKey]);
   00346: 
   00347:   const src = list[i] || "";
   00348: 
   00349:   const onError = () => {
   00350:     setI((prev) => (prev < list.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev));
   00351:   };
   00352: 
   00353:   return (
   00354:     <div
   00355:       style={{
   00356:         width: size,
   00357:         height: size,
   00358:         borderRadius: 16,
   00359:         border: "1px solid rgba(201,168,62,0.36)",
   00360:         background:
   00361:           "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04), rgba(0,0,0,0.28))",
   00362:         display: "grid",
   00363:         placeItems: "center",
   00364:         overflow: "hidden",
   00365:         boxShadow: "inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
   00366:         ...style,
   00367:       }}
   00368:     >
   00369:       {src ? (
   00370:         <img
   00371:           src={src}
   00372:           alt={alt || ""}
   00373:           width={size}
   00374:           height={size}
   00375:           onError={onError}
   00376:           style={{
   00377:             width: "100%",
   00378:             height: "100%",
   00379:             objectFit: "cover",
   00380:             display: "block",
   00381:             imageRendering: "auto",
   00382:           }}
   00383:         />
   00384:       ) : (
   00385:         <div style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)", fontSize: 12 }}>
   00386:           sem imagem
   00387:         </div>
   00388:       )}
   00389:     </div>
   00390:   );
   00391: }

   01095: function TimelineSlot({

   00242: function analyzeTop3Hit(top3, resultGrupo, resultMilhar) {
   00243:   if (!Array.isArray(top3) || !top3.length) {
   00244:     return { type: "none", score: 0, position: -1 };
   00245:   }
   00246:

   00252:   const hasMilhar = /^\d{4}$/.test(milhar);
   00253: 
   00254:   if (!hasGrupo && !hasMilhar) {
   00255:     return { type: "none", score: 0, position: -1 };
   00256:   }
   00257:

   00259: 
   00260:   top3.forEach((item, idx) => {

   00262: 
   00263:     const milhares = Array.isArray(item?.milhares20)
   00264:       ? item.milhares20
   00265:       : Array.isArray(item?.milhares)
   00266:         ? item.milhares
   00267:         : [];
   00268: 
   00269:     const centenas = milhares.map((m) => centenaFromMilhar(m));
   00270: 
   00271:     let score = 0;
   00272:     let type = "miss";
   00273: 
   00274:     if (hasMilhar && milhares.includes(milhar)) {
   00275:       score = 100;
   00276:       type = "hit_exact";
   00277:     } else if (centena && centenas.includes(centena)) {
   00278:       score = 66;
   00279:       type = "hit_centena";

   00281:       score = 33;
   00282:       type = "hit_grupo";
   00283:     }
   00284: 
   00285:     if (score > best.score) {
   00286:       best = {
   00287:         type,

   00289:         position: idx + 1,
   00290:       };
   00291:     }
   00292:   });

   00833: function TimelineSlot({
   00834:   slot,

   00958: export default function Top3View(props) {
   00959:   const {

   00977: 
   00978:   const forecastSlot = useMemo(() => {
   00979:   if (!Array.isArray(timelineTop3) || !timelineTop3.length) return null;
   00980: 
   00981:   return timelineTop3.find((slot) =>
   00982:     String(slot?.targetYmd || "").trim() === String(analysisYmd || "").trim() &&
   00983:     String(slot?.targetHour || "").trim() === String(analysisHourBucket || "").trim()

   00986: 
   00987: const list = Array.isArray(forecastSlot?.top3)
   00988:   ? forecastSlot.top3.slice(0, 3)
   00989:   : [];
   00990:   const timeline = (Array.isArray(timelineTop3) ? timelineTop3 : [])
   00991:   .slice()
   00992:   .sort((a, b) => {
   00993:     const ta = `${a?.targetYmd || ""} ${a?.targetHour || ""}`;
   00994:     const tb = `${b?.targetYmd || ""} ${b?.targetHour || ""}`;
   00995:     return ta.localeCompare(tb);
   00996:   });
   00997: 
   00998:   const showDetailedTimeline = false;
   00999: 
   01000:   const meta = useMemo(() => {

   01006: 
   01007:   const headerBase = useMemo(() => meta.last || "—", [meta.last]);

   00001: function clampProb(v) {
   00002:   const n = Number(v);
   00003: 
   00004:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
   00005:   if (n > 1) return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / 100));
   00006: 
   00007:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
   00008: }
   00009: 
   00010: function isValidGrupo(g) {
   00011:   const n = Number(g);
   00012:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 25;
   00013: }
   00014:

   00109: function top3ItemMatchesSlot(item, slot) {

   00001: "use strict";
   00002: 
   00003: import { buildFrequencyEvidence } from "./frequencyEvidence";
   00004: import { buildContextEvidence } from "./contextEvidence";
   00005: 
   00006: /**
   00007:  * Evidence Engine
   00008:  *
>> 00009:  * Centraliza todos os módulos de evidência.
   00010:  * Cada módulo produz fatos; nenhum decide o resultado.
   00011:  */
   00012: 
   00013: const MODULES = {
   00014:   frequency: buildFrequencyEvidence,
   00015:   context: buildContextEvidence,
   00016: };
   00017: 
   00018: function collectEvidence({
   00019:   item = {},
   00020:   context = {},
   00021:   config = {},
   00022: } = {}) {
   00023: 
   00024:   const evidence = [];
   00025:   const enabled = config.evidenceModules || {};
   00026: 
   00027:   for (const [name, builder] of Object.entries(MODULES)) {
   00028: 
   00029:     if (!enabled[name]?.enabled) {
   00030:       continue;
   00031:     }
   00032: 
   00033:     try {
   00034: 
   00035:       const result = builder(item, context);
   00036: 
   00037:       if (result) {
   00038:         evidence.push(result);
   00039:       }
   00040: 
   00041:     } catch (err) {
   00042: 
   00043:       evidence.push({
   00044:         module: name,
   00045:         error: true,
   00046:         message: err.message,
   00047:       });
   00048: 
   00049:     }
   00050: 
   00051:   }
   00052: 
   00053:   return {
   00054: 
   00055:     count: evidence.filter(e => !e.error).length,
   00056: 
   00057:     modules: evidence
   00058:       .filter(e => !e.error)
   00059:       .map(e => e.module),
   00060: 
   00061:     evidence,
   00062: 
   00063:   };
   00064: 
   00065: }
   00066: 
   00067: export {
   00068: collectEvidence,
   00069: };

   00200: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
   00201:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
   00202:   if (!s0) return "";
   00203: 
   00204:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   00205: 
   00206:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
   00207:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
   00208: 
   00209:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
   00210:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
   00211: 
   00212:   const mHm = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
   00213:   if (mHm) {
   00214:     const hh = String(mHm[1]).slice(0, -2);
   00215:     const mm = String(mHm[1]).slice(-2);
   00216:     if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(hh) && /^\d{2}$/.test(mm)) {
   00217:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${mm}`;
   00218:     }
   00219:   }
   00220: 
   00221:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
   00222:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
   00223: 
   00224:   return s0.trim();
   00225: }

>> 00381:  * Não colapsar dois draws distintos do mesmo dia/horário com lottery_code diferente.
   00382:  */
   00383: function dedupeDrawsLocal(draws) {
   00384:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
   00385: 
   00386:   const byKey = new Map();
   00387:   const order = [];
   00388: 
   00389:   function score(d) {
   00390:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
   00391:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
   00392:       ? Number(d.prizesCount)
   00393:       : 0;
   00394:     const hasLogical = !!(d?.ymd && d?.close_hour);
   00395:     return prizesLen * 1_000_000 + pc * 1_000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
   00396:   }
   00397: 
   00398:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
   00399:     const raw = arr[i] || {};
   00400: 
   00401:     const ymd = raw.ymd || normalizeToYMD(raw.date) || "";
   00402:     const hour = normalizeHourLike(raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "");
   00403: 
   00404:     const lotCode = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(raw);
   00405: 
   00406:     const drawId = raw.drawId ?? raw.id ?? raw.__name__ ?? null;
   00407:     const idStr = drawId != null ? String(drawId) : "";
   00408: 
   00409:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hour);
   00410: 
   00411:     const key = hasLogical
   00412:       ? lotCode
   00413:         ? `${ymd}__${hour}__${lotCode}`
   00414:         : `${ymd}__${hour}`
   00415:       : `id__${idStr || `idx_${i}`}`;
   00416: 
   00417:     const normalized = {
   00418:       ...raw,
   00419:       ymd: ymd || raw.ymd || null,
   00420:       close_hour: hour || raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "",
   00421:       closeHour: hour || raw.closeHour || raw.close_hour || "",
   00422:       lottery_code: lotCode || raw.lottery_code || raw.lotteryCode || null,
   00423:       drawId: raw.drawId || raw.id || raw.__name__ || null,
   00424:       id: raw.id || raw.drawId || raw.__name__ || null,
   00425:     };
   00426: 
   00427:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
   00428:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
   00429:       order.push(key);
   00430:       continue;
   00431:     }
   00432: 
   00433:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
   00434:     if (score(normalized) > score(prev)) {
   00435:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
   00436:     }
   00437:   }
   00438: 
   00439:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
   00440: }

   00442: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
   00443:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
   00444:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
   00445:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
   00446:   let idx = 0;
   00447: 
   00448:   async function worker() {
   00449:     while (true) {
   00450:       const current = idx;
   00451:       idx += 1;
   00452:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
   00453:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
   00454:     }
   00455:   }
   00456: 
   00457:   await Promise.all(
   00458:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
   00459:   );
   00460:   return results;
   00461: }

   00045: function brToYMD(br) {
   00046:   const m = String(br || "")
   00047:     .trim()
   00048:     .match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
   00049:   if (!m) return null;
   00050:   return `${m[3]}-${m[2]}-${m[1]}`;
   00051: }
   00052: 
   00053: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
   00054:   if (!input) return null;
   00055: 
   00056:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
   00057:     return `${input.getFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00058:       input.getDate()
   00059:     )}`;
   00060:   }
   00061: 
   00062:   // ✅ Timestamp-like / objetos com toDate()
   00063:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
   00064:     const d = input.toDate();
   00065:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00066:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00067:         d.getDate()
   00068:       )}`;
   00069:     }
   00070:   }
   00071: 
   00072:   if (
   00073:     typeof input === "object" &&
   00074:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
   00075:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
   00076:   ) {
   00077:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
   00078:       ? Number(input.seconds)
   00079:       : Number(input._seconds);
   00080: 
   00081:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
   00082:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00083:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
   00084:         d.getDate()
   00085:       )}`;
   00086:     }
   00087:   }
   00088: 
   00089:   const s = safeStr(input);
   00090:   if (!s) return null;
   00091: 
   00092:   // ISO com ou sem hora
   00093:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
   00094:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
   00095: 
   00096:   // BR "dd/mm/yyyy"
   00097:   const y = brToYMD(s);
   00098:   if (y) return y;
   00099: 
   00100:   return null;
   00101: }
   00102: 
   00103: /* =========================
   00104:    Horas
   00105: ========================= */
   00106: 
   00107: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
   00108:   const s0 = safeStr(value);
   00109:   if (!s0) return "";
   00110:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   00111: 
   00112:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);

   00003:  * ============================================================
   00004:  * buildPalpite (PalPitaco) — V1 (Opção C) [FECHADO]
   00005:  * ============================================================
   00006:  *
   00007:  * Objetivo:
   00008:  * - Gerar palpite 4 dígitos ("milhar") POR GRUPO (01..25)
   00009:  *
   00010:  * Regras (NÃO ALTERAR sem recalibração):
>> 00011:  * - Usa amostra mínima do HORÁRIO-ALVO (bucket) quando informado
   00012:  * - Baseia-se SOMENTE nos draws mais recentes
   00013:  *
   00014:  * Critérios:
   00015:  * - Dezena: mais frequente
   00016:  * - Empate: mais recente (lastSeen)
   00017:  * - Milhar/Centena: mais frequente entre números que terminam na dezena
   00018:  * - Empate: mais recente
   00019:  *
   00020:  * Contrato:
   00021:  * - Não inventa dados
   00022:  * - Não força minDraws se a base não tiver
   00023:  * - Deduplica draws para evitar inflação estatística
   00024:  * ============================================================
   00025:  *
   00026:  * ============================================================
   00027:  * buildPalpiteV2 — (NOVO) Palpite por FREQUÊNCIA + ANTIGUIDADE
   00028:  * ============================================================
   00029:  *
   00030:  * Objetivo (conforme combinado AGORA):
   00031:  * - Gerar palpite 4 dígitos ("milhar") POR GRUPO (01..25)
   00032:  * - Respeitar o RECORTE ATUAL (global ou filtrado), sem janela "mais recente"
   00033:  *
   00034:  * Critérios:
   00035:  * - Dezena: mais frequente
   00036:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA (primeira aparição no tempo)
   00037:  * - Unidade de centena (3º dígito da direita): mais frequente
   00038:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA
   00039:  * - Unidade de milhar (4º dígito da direita): mais frequente
   00040:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA
   00041:  *
   00042:  * Montagem:
   00043:  * - palpite = [milharDigit][centenaDigit][dezena(2)]
   00044:  *
   00045:  * Contrato:
   00046:  * - Deduplica draws para evitar inflação estatística
   00047:  * - Não inventa dados: se não houver números no recorte, retorna null para o grupo
   00048:  * ============================================================
   00049:  */

   00079: function toMilhar4(input) {

   00083:   if (digits.length >= 4) return digits.slice(-4).padStart(4, "0");

   00086:   if (digits.length === 1) return `000${digits}`;

   00079: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
   00080:   if (!input) return null;
   00081: 
   00082:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
   00083:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
   00084:     const d = input.toDate();
   00085:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00086:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
   00087:     }
   00088:   }
   00089: 
   00090:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
   00091:   if (
   00092:     typeof input === "object" &&
   00093:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
   00094:   ) {
   00095:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
   00096:       ? Number(input.seconds)
   00097:       : Number(input._seconds);
   00098: 
   00099:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
   00100:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
   00101:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
   00102:     }
   00103:   }
   00104: 
   00105:   // Date
   00106:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
   00107:     return `${input.getFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(input.getDate())}`;
   00108:   }
   00109: 
   00110:   const s = String(input).trim();
   00111:   if (!s) return null;
   00112: 
   00113:   // YYYY-MM-DD...
   00114:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
   00115:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
   00116: 
   00117:   // DD/MM/YYYY
   00118:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
   00119:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
   00120: 
   00121:   return null;
   00122: }

   00134: /**
   00135:  * ✅ DEDUP DE DRAWS (CORREÇÃO CRÍTICA)
   00136:  * - Prioriza a chave LÓGICA (ymd + close_hour) para eliminar duplicidade real
   00137:  * - Só cai para id/drawId se NÃO conseguir montar (ymd/hour)
   00138:  * - Se ainda assim ficar sem chave, usa fallback com índice (não colapsa tudo em "__")
   00139:  */
   00140: function dedupeDraws(draws) {
   00141:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
   00142:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
   00143: 
   00144:   const seen = new Set();
   00145:   const out = [];
   00146: 
   00147:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
   00148:     const d = arr[i];
   00149: 
   00150:     const ymd =
   00151:       String(d?.ymd || "").trim() ||
   00152:       normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d)) ||
   00153:       "";
   00154: 
   00155:     const hour = getDrawHourRaw(d);
   00156: 
   00157:     const logicalKey = ymd && hour ? `${ymd}__${hour}` : "";
   00158:     const fallbackKey =
   00159:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
   00160:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
   00161:       "";
   00162: 
   00163:     const key = logicalKey || fallbackKey || `${ymd || "nodate"}__${hour || "nohour"}__idx${i}`;
   00164: 
   00165:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
   00166:     seen.add(key);
   00167:     out.push(d);
   00168:   }
   00169: 
   00170:   return out;
   00171: }
   00172: 
   00173: /**
   00174:  * ✅ Dedup defensivo de prizes dentro do mesmo draw
   00175:  * - prioridade: prizeId (se existir)
>> 00176:  * - fallback: position + grupo + animal
   00177:  * - se position vier vazio, ainda assim diferencia por "idx" para não colapsar tudo
   00178:  */
   00179: function dedupePrizes(prizes) {
   00180:   const arr = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes : [];
   00181:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
   00182: 
   00183:   const seen = new Set();
   00184:   const out = [];
   00185: 
   00186:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
   00187:     const p = arr[i];
   00188: 
   00189:     const grupoRaw = p?.grupo ?? p?.group ?? "";
>> 00190:     const animalRaw = p?.animal ?? "";
   00191:     const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? "";
   00192: 
>> 00193:     const baseFallback = `${String(posRaw)}__${String(grupoRaw)}__${normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw)}`;
   00194:     const key =
   00195:       (p?.prizeId != null && String(p.prizeId)) ||
   00196:       (String(posRaw).trim() ? baseFallback : `${baseFallback}__idx${i}`);
   00197: 
   00198:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
   00199:     seen.add(key);
   00200:     out.push(p);
   00201:   }
   00202: 
   00203:   return out;
   00204: }
   00205: 
   00206: /* =========================
   00207:    Main
   00208: ========================= */
   00209: export function buildRanking(draws, opts = {}) {
   00210:   // ✅ correção: dedup no nível de draws ANTES de qualquer métrica
   00211:   const list = dedupeDraws(Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []);
   00212: 
   00213:   // Padrão atual (mantido): conta por prize
   00214:   const countMode = String(opts.countMode || "byPrize"); // "byPrize" | "byDraw"
   00215:   const maxIntegrityIssues = Number.isFinite(Number(opts.maxIntegrityIssues))
   00216:     ? Math.max(0, Number(opts.maxIntegrityIssues))
   00217:     : 300;
   00218: 
   00219:   const totalDraws = list.length;
   00220: 
   00221:   // metas de período
   00222:   const daySet = new Set();
   00223:   let minDate = null;
   00224:   let maxDate = null;
   00225: 
   00226:   for (const d of list) {
   00227:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d));
   00228:     if (!ymd) continue;
   00229: 
   00230:     daySet.add(ymd);
   00231:     if (!minDate || ymd < minDate) minDate = ymd;
   00232:     if (!maxDate || ymd > maxDate) maxDate = ymd;
   00233:   }
   00234: 
   00235:   const uniqueDays = daySet.size;
   00236: 
   00237:   // ranking
   00238:   const map = new Map();
   00239:   let totalOcorrencias = 0;
   00240: 
>> 00241:   // auditoria de consistência grupo x animal
   00242:   const integrityIssues = [];
   00243: 
   00244:   for (const draw of list) {
   00245:     const prizes = dedupePrizes(draw?.prizes);
   00246: 
   00247:     // se countMode = byDraw, evitamos contar o mesmo grupo mais de 1x por draw
   00248:     const countedGroupsThisDraw = countMode === "byDraw" ? new Set() : null;
   00249: 
   00250:     for (const prize of prizes) {
   00251:       const grupoRaw = prize?.grupo ?? prize?.group;
>> 00252:       const animalRaw = prize?.animal;
   00253: 
   00254:       if (grupoRaw == null) continue;
   00255: 
   00256:       const grupoNum = Number(grupoRaw);
   00257:       if (!Number.isFinite(grupoNum)) continue;
   00258:       if (grupoNum < 1 || grupoNum > 25) continue;
   00259: 
   00260:       if (countedGroupsThisDraw) {
   00261:         const k = String(grupoNum);
   00262:         if (countedGroupsThisDraw.has(k)) continue;
   00263:         countedGroupsThisDraw.add(k);
   00264:       }
   00265: 
   00266:       const official = getOfficialByGrupo(grupoNum);
   00267:       const grupo = official?.grupo || pad2(grupoNum);
   00268: 
>> 00269:       const animalFromData = animalRaw ? normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw) : "";
>> 00270:       const animalOfficial = official?.animal || "";
>> 00271:       const animalLabel = animalFromData || animalOfficial || "";
   00272: 
   00273:       let entry = map.get(grupo);
   00274:       if (!entry) {
   00275:         entry = {
   00276:           grupo,                 // "01".."25" (string)
   00277:           grupoNum: grupoNum,    // 1..25 (number)
>> 00278:           animal: animalLabel,   // "GATO"
   00279:           slug: official?.slug || "",
   00280:           dezenas: official?.dezenas || [],
   00281:           total: 0,
   00282:         };
   00283:         map.set(grupo, entry);
   00284:       } else {
   00285:         // completa metadados se necessário
   00286:         if (!entry.grupoNum) entry.grupoNum = grupoNum;
   00287:         if (!entry.slug && official?.slug) entry.slug = official.slug;
   00288:         if ((!entry.dezenas || !entry.dezenas.length) && official?.dezenas?.length) {
   00289:           entry.dezenas = official.dezenas;
   00290:         }
>> 00291:         if (!entry.animal && animalLabel) entry.animal = animalLabel;
   00292:       }
   00293: 
>> 00294:       // auditoria: se veio animal no dado e diverge do oficial, registra e “trava” no oficial
   00295:       if (
>> 00296:         animalFromData &&
>> 00297:         animalOfficial &&
>> 00298:         animalFromData !== animalOfficial &&
   00299:         integrityIssues.length < maxIntegrityIssues
   00300:       ) {
   00301:         integrityIssues.push({
   00302:           drawId: draw?.drawId ?? draw?.id ?? null,
   00303:           date: getDrawYmdRaw(draw),
   00304:           close_hour: getDrawHourRaw(draw) || null,
   00305:           grupo,
   00306:           grupoNum,
>> 00307:           animal_no_dado: animalRaw,
>> 00308:           animal_normalizado: animalFromData,
>> 00309:           animal_oficial: animalOfficial,
   00310:         });
   00311: 
>> 00312:         if (animalOfficial) entry.animal = animalOfficial;
   00313:       }
   00314: 
   00315:       entry.total += 1;
   00316:       totalOcorrencias += 1;
   00317:     }
   00318:   }
   00319: 
   00320:   // garante 01..25 sempre presentes
   00321:   for (let i = 1; i <= 25; i += 1) {
   00322:     const official = getOfficialByGrupo(i);
   00323:     const g = official?.grupo || pad2(i);
   00324: 
   00325:     let entry = map.get(g);
   00326: 
   00327:     if (!entry) {
   00328:       map.set(g, {
   00329:         grupo: g,
   00330:         grupoNum: i,
>> 00331:         animal: official?.animal || "",
   00332:         slug: official?.slug || "",
   00333:         dezenas: official?.dezenas || [],
   00334:         total: 0,
   00335:       });
   00336:     } else {
   00337:       if (!entry.grupoNum) entry.grupoNum = i;
>> 00338:       if (!entry.animal) entry.animal = official?.animal || "";
   00339:       if (!entry.slug) entry.slug = official?.slug || "";
   00340:       if ((!entry.dezenas || !entry.dezenas.length) && official?.dezenas?.length) {
   00341:         entry.dezenas = official.dezenas;
   00342:       }
   00343:     }
   00344:   }
   00345: 
   00346:   const ranking = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => {
   00347:     const dt = Number(b.total) - Number(a.total);
   00348:     if (dt !== 0) return dt;
   00349:     return String(a.grupo).localeCompare(String(b.grupo));
   00350:   });
   00351: 
   00352:   return {
   00353:     ranking,
   00354:     top3: ranking.slice(0, 3),
   00355:     totalOcorrencias,
   00356:     integrityIssues,
   00357:     totalDraws,
   00358:     uniqueDays,
   00359:     minDate,
   00360:     maxDate,
   00361: 
   00362:     // útil para a próxima etapa (definição de regra)
   00363:     countMode,
   00364:   };
   00365: }
